mapper.select: SELECT request_hash, status, response_status, response_content_type, response_body, expires_at FROM iam_idempotency_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_idempotency_record (tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{key}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
